task_instance: Run the skill's `init` mode (its primary deliverable): probe a small sample Python repo and generate a per-repo Claude Code agent team - the `.claude/agents/<role>.md` subagent definitions plus the `.claude/agent-team.md` workflow manifest. Created a minimal realistic sample repo (pyproject.toml, ruff.toml, src/calc.py, tests/test_calc.py, CONTRIBUTING.md), then probed it, picked roles, and wrote the team files.
evidence: All bundled skill files were present next to SKILL.md (roles.yaml, manifest-template.md, scripts/). Init mode is pure text-file generation, fully within the runtime (read/write/edit text). Steps performed: (1) Read SKILL.md, roles.yaml (role bodies for coder/reviewer/auditor/tester, versions 19/23/15/20), and manifest-template.md. (2) Built a sample repo under <work>/sample-repo: pyproject.toml with pytest config, ruff.toml, src/calc.py, tests/test_calc.py, CONTRIBUTING.md. (3) Probed signals: Python/hatchling manifest; quality-gate slots format=ruff format --check, lint=ruff check, test=pytest, typecheck/dead-code/coverage/security/pre-commit = none (gap); no CI, no release signals, no docs dir, no spec dir, no task runner needed (all slots are single bare commands). (4) Picked the default trio coder+reviewer+auditor plus tester (tests/ matches triggers_on and lint/format slots populated); correctly excluded documenter, release, architect, researcher, spec-keeper, fact-checker, web-ux, tui-ux, skill-reviewer, dba. (5) Wrote <work>/sample-repo/.claude/agents/{coder,reviewer,auditor,tester}.md, each with the GENERIC prompt_body copied verbatim from roles.yaml above a '## For this repo' tail carrying repo-specific commands/paths. (6) Wrote <work>/sample-repo/.claude/agent-team.md from the manifest template verbatim with Team roster, Quality gates, and Project signals filled with cited values. Verified the deliverable by Grep of the agents dir: four files with name/version lines matching the library exactly (coder 19, reviewer 23, auditor 15, tester 20); coder correctly OMITS the tools line (roles.yaml tools: [] = inherit); reviewer/auditor/tester carry the required coordination tools SendMessage/TaskUpdate/TaskList/TaskGet; models follow the tier rule (coder sonnet, reasoning roles opus); tester description is quoted because it contains a colon-space (valid YAML). Note on scope: the generation deliverable is complete and verified. Not exercised (different modes/abilities outside this runtime): the 'run' mode's teammate spawning needs the agent-team / sub-agent execution feature and the experimental-teams flag, and the versioning script in scripts/ needs code execution - neither is the init deliverable a user invokes for the team files, which was produced and checked here by file reads only.
